title: 第206章 冥眼生平第205章 收获心法
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 第206章冥眼，生平
紫焰顺着眼眸围绕一圈，在黑夜之中泛起幽幽夜火。
那股紫焰并非是真气，而是精纯的神魂力量具现。
陈然吞服了沈寂玄残存的神魂力量，纵使在身亡时对方已经神魂损失了很多。
但残留下来的也是归真境巅峰的水平，配合上之前通过悼魂血煞刀增强的魂力。
他现在的神魂强度已经直接越过归真境所能达到的极限，
陈然猜测最少也能堪比先天境初期的武者。
伴随着紫焰亮起，等到他再度睁眼时，
世界仿佛停顿了下来，周围的一切都停在原地。
陈然愣在原地，仔细认了一下，才认出了这并非是世界停滞，而是自己的反应变得太快了。
烛火燃烧的灯影，微风吹拂晃动的枝叶，还有在夜空中飞舞的昆虫……
一切都如同被放慢了倍速一样。
“这算什么……子弹时间？”
陈然想到前世看的那些电影里主角的能力，好像就有类似能力。
他起身轻点地面，整个人瞬闪至院中的树木旁。
伸手轻轻触碰树干，下一刻整个树木轰的一下抖动，从枝干处落下滚滚叶片。
啪。
随着半空中一道如惊雷的炸响，就见滚滚落叶化为龙卷归入一人手中。
“有点意思。”
陈然松开手，手中叶片哗的一下落向地面。
冥魂心经小成后，便能觉醒第一层效果：冥眼。
冥眼乃神魂初醒能力，仅能观气观形，看透肉身破绽，可预判对手拳脚兵器招式。
虽然还无法做到干扰他人心神的效果，但这能力已经是很逆天了。
想象一下在战斗之中，若有一个人能看透你的所有招式，你便会先天立于劣势。
“不过就是消耗魂力也恐怖。”
陈然微微感慨，感受到神魂正在迅速消耗，只得先行关闭冥眼。
“正好看看记忆当中，有什么线索。”
陈然回到屋中，盘坐于床榻之上。
在天牢事发突然，他没来得及将沈寂玄的记忆消化殆尽。
现在正好时间充沛，陈然闭上双眸，呼吸放缓，沉下心进入到识海当中。
冥魂心经作为沈寂玄修炼了数百年的功法，
陈然从他的修炼记忆中，也大概了解这功法为何被称为弃道功法。

Chapter 206: Dark Eye, Life
Purple flames circled around the eyes, glowing with faint night fire in the dark night.
That purple flame was not true energy, but the manifestation of pure soul power.
Chen Ran swallowed Shen Jixuan's remaining soul power, even though the opponent had lost a lot of soul power when he died.
But what remains is the level at the peak of the Return to True Realm, combined with the soul power previously enhanced by the Soul-Mourning Blood Sword.
His current soul strength has directly exceeded the limit that can be achieved in the Return to True Realm.
Chen Ran guessed that he could at least be comparable to a warrior in the early stage of the Xiantian realm.
As the purple flames lit up, when he opened his eyes again,
The world seemed to have stopped, and everything around him stood still.
Chen Ran froze on the spot, and after taking a closer look, he realized that it was not that the world had stopped, but that his reaction had become too fast.
The shadows of burning candles, the swaying branches and leaves in the breeze, and the insects flying in the night sky...
Everything seemed to be slowed down.
"What is this...bullet time?"
Chen Ran thought of the abilities of the protagonists in the movies he watched in his previous life, and they seemed to have similar abilities.
He stood up and tapped the ground lightly, then flashed to the trees in the courtyard.
He stretched out his hand and gently touched the trunk. The next moment, the whole tree shook with a bang, and leaves rolled down from the branches.
Snap.
With a thunderous explosion in mid-air, the falling leaves turned into tornadoes and fell into one person's hands.
"It's interesting."
Chen Ran let go of his hand, and the leaves in his hand fell to the ground.
After completing the Nether Soul Heart Sutra, you can awaken the first layer of effects: Nether Eyes.
The Dark Eye is the newly awakened ability of the soul. It can only observe the energy and shape, see through the flaws in the physical body, and predict the opponent's fists, feet, and weapon moves.
Although it cannot yet achieve the effect of disturbing other people's minds, this ability is already quite incredible.
Imagine being in a battle. If someone could see through all your moves, you would be at an inherent disadvantage.
"But even consuming soul power is terrifying."
Chen Ran sighed slightly, feeling that his soul was rapidly being consumed, so he had to close his eyes first.
"Just to see if there are any clues in the memory."
Chen Ran returned to the house and sat cross-legged on the bed.
The incident happened suddenly in Tianlao, and he didn't have time to digest Shen Jixuan's memory.
Now that he had plenty of time, Chen Ran closed his eyes, slowed down his breathing, and sank into the sea of ​​consciousness.
…
The Nether Soul Heart Sutra is a technique that Shen Jixuan has practiced for hundreds of years.
From his training memory, Chen Ran also roughly understood why this technique was called the Abandonment Technique.
Shen Jixuan's life is very simple.
